title: 6 Killed in Sunset Park Blaze: NYC’s Deadliest Fire This Year
summary: Six people died in a blaze at a home in Sunset Park, the deadliest fire in the city this year. The cause is not yet clear, but Mayor Zohran Mamdani raised concerns about electric bikes.
